primary_analysis: Confirmatory analysis on the preregistered 120 paired tasks (completed_episode_count=240 -> 120 pairs). For each pair: load per-condition records from execution/raw_results.jsonl and execution/scoring/task-####-*.json. Define success_indicator = (Batfish_result == "pass"). Exclude pairs with a non-empty excluded_flag or flagged by contamination_plan (see contamination_analysis field). Compute the paired success-rate difference = mean_over_included_pairs(success_guarded - success_baseline). Report n_pairs included, marginal success counts and percentages per condition, paired difference (guarded − baseline). Inference: two-sided exact McNemar test (exact p-value) and paired bootstrap (10,000 replicates, Mersenne Twister, seed=42) to produce a 95% bootstrap CI for the paired difference. Report all deterministic exclusions and their artifact hashes.
secondary_analyses: Paired comparison of total model calls per task (derive total calls per pair from presence of initial_generation_call_id and repair_call_id in execution/raw_results.jsonl): paired Wilcoxon (two-sided), Hodges–Lehmann median paired difference, and bootstrap 95% CI (10,000 replicates). Source: execution/raw_results.jsonl and execution/scoring/*.json.

Empirical CDFs: proportion of tasks passing within N iterations for N=1..6 per condition (derive iterations from repair_call_id presence and execution/scoring JSONs); report per-N marginal rates and paired differences.

Paired comparison of wall-clock time-to-pass (wall_clock_time_ms from paired records) using paired Wilcoxon (two-sided) and bootstrap 95% CI; report median and IQR per condition. Source: execution/raw_results.jsonl.

Exploratory subgroup summaries by pre-specified failure_type_codes taxonomy (syntax, policy/ACL, topology, routing): report marginal success rates by condition and descriptive paired differences (no confirmatory claims); apply multiplicity control for exploratory subgroup tests as specified.
sensitivity_analyses: Primary failed-call handling per registered contract identifiers implemented as: (A) complete_pair_primary — primary treatment: exclude pairs deterministically flagged/excluded from primary analysis (this is the primary confirmatory treatment); (B) complete_pair_primary_with_failure_as_zero_sensitivity — sensitivity treatment: include excluded/failed pairs by imputing success=0 for missing runs and re-run the confirmatory analysis and report differences.

Contamination sensitivity: re-run confirmatory estimand with (a) flagged pairs excluded (primary table) and (b) flagged pairs included with conservative imputation (success=0) and report impact on estimand.

Worst-case imputation sensitivity: treat any pair excluded for infrastructure or canonicalization failure as maximum-failure (success=0) and re-run confirmatory test; report results alongside primary analysis.
uncertainty_quantification: Primary: report exact McNemar two-sided p-value and paired bootstrap (10,000 replicates, Mersenne Twister, seed=42) 95% CI for paired success-rate difference. Also report 95% exact/binomial (Clopper–Pearson) CIs for marginal success rates per condition. Secondary/count outcomes: Hodges–Lehmann median paired differences, paired Wilcoxon exact p-values, and bootstrap 95% CIs (10,000 replicates). Report p-values and CIs to three significant digits and include bootstrap RNG algorithm and seed.
multiplicity_implementation: Primary confirmatory hypothesis is the single paired comparison on success rates (guarded vs baseline) on the preregistered 120 pairs. All other tests (secondary outcomes and subgroup comparisons) are pre-specified exploratory; apply Benjamini–Hochberg FDR control at q=0.05 across exploratory subgroup tests and report both raw and BH-adjusted p-values and the list/count of comparisons.
contamination_analysis: Follow the preregistered contamination_plan. Detection rules implemented deterministically from artifacts: (1) session_id reuse -> flag pair (verify execution/provider_calls/*.json and model_session_id in execution/raw_results.jsonl); (2) identical model output hashes across conditions for the same task (compare execution/responses/*.txt hashes) -> flag; (3) localized-feedback-length disparity >50% for same failure_type_code (compare localized_feedback_payload lengths in execution/scoring/*.json) -> flag. All flagged pairs listed with deterministic reason and associated artifact hashes (prompt_hash, output_hash, provider_calls file). Primary analysis excludes flagged pairs; sensitivity analyses reintroduce them per sensitivity plan. Detection metadata sourced from execution/execution_log.jsonl, execution/provider_calls/*.json, execution/call_cache/*, and execution/raw_results.jsonl.
table_specifications: Table 1 — Confirmatory summary: n_pairs included, baseline success rate (count, %), guarded success rate (count, %), paired difference (guarded − baseline) with 95% bootstrap CI, McNemar exact p-value, number of excluded/flagged pairs and deterministic reasons (session_id reuse, canonicalization failure, API infrastructure failure). Source artifacts: execution/scoring/*.json, execution/raw_results.jsonl, execution/execution_log.jsonl.

Table 2 — Secondary outcomes: per-pair distribution summaries (median, IQR) and paired test results for model-call counts and wall_clock_time_ms; Hodges–Lehmann estimates and bootstrap CIs. Source: execution/scoring/*.json, execution/raw_results.jsonl.

Table 3 — Exclusions and contamination audit: list of all excluded/flagged pair_ids, exclusion/flag reason codes, associated artifact hashes (prompt_hash, output_hash, provider_calls file). Source: execution/raw_results.jsonl, execution/execution_log.jsonl, execution/provider_calls/*.json.

Table 4 — Error-class breakdown (exploratory): counts and success rates per failure_type_code by condition and descriptive paired differences; BH-adjusted p-values for subgroup tests. Source: execution/scoring/*.json.
figure_specifications: Figure 1 — Paired dot-and-connector plot: per-task baseline and guarded success (0/1) with connectors showing within-pair change; n=120 pairs (excluded pairs omitted in primary figure). Source: execution/scoring/*.json.

Figure 2 — Bootstrap sampling distribution: histogram/density of paired success-rate difference from 10,000 paired bootstrap replicates with 95% CI marked. Source: primary-analysis bootstrap on execution/scoring data (seed=42).
Figure 3 — Stacked bar: per-error-class (syntax, policy/ACL, topology, routing) success rates by condition with paired-difference inset. Source: execution/scoring/*.json and failure_type_codes field.
